motion_classification.method: decoded BVH forward kinematics: foot-height autocorrelation period, L/R cross-correlation phase offset, foot-lift amplitude, per-frame root travel. Filenames were NOT trusted.
motion_classification.calibration: thresholds set against controls: zombie.bvh (the ACCEPTED walk) must classify WALKING; idle/standing clips must classify NOT WALKING
motion_classification.first_attempt_error: an initial contact-alternation classifier produced a FALSE NEGATIVE on zombie.bvh itself and was discarded, not reported

search_step_4_external.conclusion: external SEARCH is not possible: the GitHub API and code search are denied, so only already-known paths can be fetched. Guessing repository paths is not a principled search and would risk pulling an asset whose licence and skeleton were never verified. No external download was attempted.

why_not_found: the fair1 skeleton naming (LeftUpLeg/LeftLeg/LeftFoot, Spine1-3) is the Mixamo/HumanIK convention, and the owner excluded Mixamo for AI/ML licence ambiguity. The only cleanly-licensed fair1 corpus available here is the AnimatedDrawings set, which contains exactly one walking clip: the current source.
